public_rationale: The OpenAI $50 billion figure is corroborated as a 2026 spending plan. It does not establish a current annualized rate. Anthropic's later filing reports Q2 compute and infrastructure expenses equivalent to about $22.2 billion annually on simple annualization, materially below $50 billion. That is relevant counterevidence, but accounting expenses and cash spending are not interchangeable. No comparable global $100 billion total was established.
limitations: The result depends on what annual spending means.
The company-level sources do not measure the same scope as the global estimate.
Annualizing a growing company's quarter does not predict its full-year expenditure.
